definitions.dynamicsReason: Every measured manifest sets presentation.dynamics to normal-speed. The live ear uses that. The harness default is total-speed, so this run sets face speed explicitly.

grid.source: docs/experiments/foundry/ricochet-garden-loop/sweep.json broadGrid. That file records seed 20261110, also not applied to the solver.

definitions.noteSequence: Ordered sounding notes. A sounding note is a resonance impact with gain > 0. Written piece:pitch in onset order, joined by >.
definitions.audibleEvent: Sounding notes in onset order. A note joins the current event when its onset is at most 150 ms after the previous note. Otherwise it starts a new event. A chord is one event.
definitions.phraseLength: Raw length is the sounding-note count. Audible length is the event count. Bins are 0, 1-2, 3-5, and 6+ for both.
definitions.phraseFamily: Collapse immediate repeats of the same sounding piece, then take the first three distinct pieces in order of appearance. Fewer than three distinct pieces is a short family, written short: then those pieces joined by >. No sounding notes is (silent).
definitions.nudge: One slider step: yaw ±0.5°, elevation ±0.5°, charge ±0.01. Both directions. Reported for shots that already have 3+ raw notes, and again for shots that already have 3+ audible events. Per direction is the share of those individual steps. Both directions means the shot only counts when each way meets the condition. All six means every step meets it. Same family but different sequence means the phrase family matches and the note sequence does not.
definitions.breadth: Distinct sounding pieces on a 3+ shot. The two-piece share and the busiest-piece share are of every sounding note on the grid. Ping-pong is, per 3+ shot, the share of that shot’s notes from its own two most-hit pieces.
definitions.regions: Left is yaw ≤ -8, centre is -6 through 6, right is yaw ≥ 8. Low elevation is 8, 12, and 16. High is 20, 24, 30, and 40. Six regions.
definitions.contactOrder: Every contact in ledger order. The worldcraft-object- prefix is stripped. Ground stays as ground and the tee stays as tee. Silent pieces stay. Repeats stay.
definitions.pitchSequence: After the 150 ms merge, each event is its pitches in onset order joined by +. Events are joined by >.
